To: Imani Rasmussen, Cyrus Moreau, Rhys Cho, Leon Yamamoto, Cleo Ishikawa, Emeka Delacroix, and Kestrel Site Leads (12 total)
From: Maeve

Colleagues,

In accordance with the Project Kestrel rollout plan approved by the Brightbridge Hospitality Group operations committee, a daily coordination standup will be convened for the duration of the transition period across the three pilot locations.

The purpose of this session is to support operational continuity during the rollout. Attendance by each location's general manager or designated alternate is requested. Kitchen and front-of-house leads are asked to attend where scheduling permits.

Sessions will be held each weekday at 10:15 AM, prior to lunch service, and will not exceed 15 minutes. Participants are asked to be prepared to raise any item that may affect service that day. Matters requiring extended discussion will be referred to a separate follow-up as determined by the facilitator.

Imani Rasmussen will serve as alternate facilitator in my absence.

Please confirm receipt.

Regards,
Maeve
